blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Semantic change detection in remote sensing aims to identify and characterize land-cover transitions observed in pairs of satellite or aerial images. Existing methods assume a fixed set of change categories, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where changes of interest may vary, for example across geographies or over time. In this work, we tackle the problem of class-incremental semantic change detection, where a model progressively learns to detect new types of semantic change. To do so, we exploit the hierarchical structure of land-cover semantics, where newly introduced categories correspond to fine-grained refinements of existing ones, and represent said semantic categories in hyperbolic space, which is particularly well suited to represent such hierarchical relationships. To capture semantic changes, we introduce HyperFlow, a method relying on Busemann prototypes, modeling change as an anomaly in a learned semantic flow within the hyperbolic embedding space induced by segmentation. HyperFlow couples change detection to class-incremental semantic segmentation, enabling class-incremental semantic change detection. We also present HiChange, a new large-scale, high resolution remote sensing dataset with detailed, fine-grained hierarchical labels. Experimental results demonstrate that HyperFlow achieves both strong change detection and semantic segmentation performance across incremental steps. In particular, we show that progressively refining semantic categories, rather than considering them all directly, yields improved change detection, highlighting the benefits of incremental learning for semantic change detection.
blocks.zh: 遥感中的语义变化探测旨在识别和描述在对等卫星或航空图像中观测到的土地覆盖过渡。 现有方法假设一套固定的改变类别,限制其在实际世界情景中的适用性,而这种情景中的兴趣变化可能有所不同,例如在地理上或随着时间推移而变化。 在这部作品中,我们解决了阶级-增量语义变化探测问题,一个模型逐渐学会了检测新型语义变化. 为此,我们利用了土地覆盖语义的分级结构,新引入的分类对应了对现有分类的精细完善,并在双曲空间中代表了所说的语义分类,这特别适合代表这种分级关系. 为了捕捉语义变化,我们引入了HyperFlow,一种依靠布斯曼原型的方法,将变化建模为被分化所诱导的双曲嵌入空间内有学问的语义流中的异常. HyperFlow夫妇更改检测为类增量语义分解,使类增量语义分解检测成为可能. 我们还提出了Hichange, 一个新的大规模高分辨率遥感数据集, 带有详细,细微的分级标签。 实验结果表明,HyperFlow既能实现强变化检测,又能实现跨增量步骤的语义分解性能. 特别是,我们表明,逐步完善语义分类,而不是直接考虑所有类别,会产生更好的变化探测,突出了增量学习对语义变化探测的好处.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Semantic change detection (SCD) aims at identifying and characterizing land cover transitions over time by comparing pairs of co-registered satellite or aerial images. Despite being a well established research field ( Jiang et al., 2022 ) with applications in disaster response ( Zheng et al., 2021 ; Ahn et al., 2025 ) , urban planning ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2021 ) or land cover analysis ( Li et al., 2016 ; Lv et al., 2023 ; Daudt et al., 2019 ) , current approaches remain static and assume a fixed set of change categories. This assumption is misaligned with real-world scenarios, where changing environmental and societal priorities imply evolving monitoring objectives ( Tasar et al., 2019 ; Weng et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Adapting models to new types of changes typically requires costly retraining and annotation, making current approaches unsuitable for long-term deployment.
blocks.zh: 语义变化探测(SCD)旨在通过比较一对共同注册的卫星或航空图像来识别并描述随着时间的推移的土地覆盖过渡. 尽管是一个已确立的研究领域(Jiang等,2022年),在救灾(Zheng等,2021年;Ahn等,2025年),城市规划(Wang等,2024年;赵等,2025年;Zheng等,2021年)或土地覆盖分析(Li等,2016年;Lv等,2023年;Daudt等,2019年)方面都有应用,但目前的方法仍然静止不变并承担了一套固定的变化类别. 这一假设与现实世界的情景不符,其中不断变化的环境和社会优先事项意味着不断变化的监测目标(Tasar等,2019;Weng等,2024;Zhang等,2023)。 使模式适应新型变化通常需要昂贵的再培训和注释,使目前的做法不适合长期部署。

blocks.en: A key observation is that land-cover categories are naturally structured in hierarchies, from broad categories like urban or vegetation to fine-grained ones such as residential building , crop field , or forest . In the context of land use monitoring, new types of changes are rarely entirely new categories; rather, they usually correspond to refining coarse classes into more specific ones, as illustrated in fig. 1 , panel (1). Leveraging this hierarchy is therefore essential to enable adaptable SCD methods and calls for change detection (CD) models that (i) explicitly represent hierarchical semantics and (ii) adapt to different levels of this hierarchy over time.
blocks.zh: 一个关键观察是,土地覆盖类别自然是按等级划分的,从城市或植被等大类到住宅建筑、作物田地或森林等细小的类别。 在土地利用监测方面,新型变化很少是全新的类别;相反,它们通常与粗细的类别相呼应,如图中所示,它们更具体。 1, 面板 (1). 因此,利用这种等级制度对于使适应性SCD方法和要求变化检测(CD)模型能够(一)明确代表等级语义和(二)随着时间的推移适应这种等级制度的不同级别至关重要。

blocks.en:
To tackle these challenges, we consider the task of class-incremental semantic change detection (CI-SCD), in which a model continuously expands the types of semantic changes it detects. First, we model land-cover semantics in hyperbolic space, which is particularly well suited to represent hierarchical structures ( Nickel and Kiela, 2017 ; Ganea et al., 2018a ; Ganea et al., 2018b ) .
Second, we leverage advances in class-incremental semantic segmentation (CISS) to advance CI-SCD.
We introduce a dynamic hyperbolic formulation of CI-SCD, where semantic categories are obtained from hierarchical embeddings in hyperbolic space, while change is modeled as an anomaly in a learned semantic flow within this structured space.
This approach couples SCD to CISS, enabling CI-SCD, and ensures that the detected changes are adapted to the updated semantic classes (see fig. 1 , panel (2)).
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们考虑了类-增量语义变化检测(CI-SCD)的任务,其中一个模型不断扩展它所探测到的语义变化的类型. 首先,我们在双曲空间模拟土地覆盖语义,这特别适合代表等级结构(Nickel和Kiela,2017;Ganea等,2018a;Ganea等,2018b.).
第二,我们利用类递增语义分解(CISS)的进展,推进CI-SCD.
我们引入了CI-SCD的动态双曲配体,其中语义类是从双曲空间上分层嵌入得到的,而改变被建模为在这个结构空间内有学识的语义流中的异常.
这种方法将 SCD 配为 CISS, 使 CI-SCD 成为可能,并确保所检测到的变化适应更新的语义类(见图一. 1, 面板(2)).

blocks.en:
Specifically, we represent pixels at different time steps as points in a shared hyperbolic embedding space induced by the segmentation. We then model change as an anomaly in a learned semantic flow in this space, i.e., a displacement between embeddings at times t 0 t_{0} and t 1 t_{1} : when a pixel changes (e.g., from vegetation to building ), its embedding moves between regions of the manifold, producing a displacement in embedding space between t 0 t_{0} and t 1 t_{1} , as illustrated in fig. 1 , panel (3). By learning the expected flow accounting for small domain shifts naturally occurring between images ( e.g . due to seasonal or illumination changes), the remaining deviations indicate the unexpected changes to be detected. To learn this semantic flow in hyperbolic space, we introduce HyperFlow, a method based on the Busemann function.
Building on prior work in hyperbolic segmentation ( Ghadimi Atigh et al., 2022 ; Berg et al., 2024 ) , CISS ( Hindel et al., 2024 ) and Riemannian vector fields ( Katsman et al., 2023 ) , we show that Busemann prototypes are the key to link this approach to CISS within a single hyperbolic method. In particular, incremental learning is handled directly through those prototypes, as depicted in fig. 1 , panel (4): when a coarse category is refined, its prototype is split to initialize fine-grained subclasses, preserving geometric proximity to the parent while enabling specialization.
The semantic flow is then retrained in this updated space, thus becoming specific to the newly introduced subclasses and allowing the detection of new semantic transitions.

基于以往在双曲分解(Ghadimi Atigh等,2022;Berg等,2024;CISS(Hindel等,2024;和Riemannian向量场(Katsman等,2023))方面的工作,我们显示布斯曼原型是在单一双曲法内将这种方法与CISS联系起来的关键. 特别是,增量学习直接通过这些原型处理,如图所示. 1,面板(4):粗细类被精炼出后,其原型被分拆出来初始化精细分级,在允许专业化的同时保持与母体的几何相近.
语义流再被再训练在这个被更新的空间中,从而成为新引入的子类的特有,并允许检测出新的语义过渡.

blocks.en:
In summary, this work makes three main contributions. First, we propose HyperFlow, a method that represents semantic categories using Busemann prototypes and models change via a semantic flow in a shared embedding space, coupling segmentation and CD in a geometrically grounded manner.
Second, we show how HyperFlow can be leveraged to address the task of CI-SCD by extending CISS methods. In this formulation, incremental refinement is achieved by splitting parent prototypes to initialize newly introduced subclasses, preserving hierarchical structure while ensuring that the semantic flow, retrained to account for this new embedding space, adapts consistently as the taxonomy evolves. Third, as current benchmarks in SCD are limited to a small number of generic semantic categories ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) lacking hierarchical structure, we present HiChange, a large-scale dataset with a rich hierarchical label structure designed to enable CI-SCD models to detect fine grained changes of increasing semantic complexity.
blocks.zh:
总之,这项工作有三个主要贡献。 首先,我们提出HyperFlow,一种代表语义分类的方法,使用布斯曼原型和模型通过在共享嵌入空间中的语义流来改变,以几何基底的方式将分解和CD相接.
第二,我们展示如何通过扩展CISS方法,利用HyperFlow来完成CI-SCD的任务. 在这个配方中,通过将母体原型分拆来初始化新引入的子类,保留分级结构,同时确保语义流出,再培训以说明这个新的嵌入空间,随着分类学的演化而一致地适应. 第三,由于SCD目前的基准仅限于少数缺乏分级结构的通类语义类(张等,2025年),因此我们提出"Hichange"(Hichange),这是一个具有丰富分级标签结构的大型数据集,旨在使CI-SCD模型能够检测日益复杂的语义的细粒变化.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Semantic Change Detection in Remote Sensing
blocks.zh: 2.1 遥感中的语义变化探测

blocks.en:
CD enables the identification of differences between remotely sensed images of the same location acquired at different times. Initially based on hand-crafted features ( Malila, 1980 ; Volpi et al., 2012 ) , recent methods leverage deep learning, typically with Siamese designs ( Daudt et al., 2018 ; Jiang et al., 2022 ) . However, such approaches rely on the quality of ground-truth change maps, which are difficult to obtain and often noisy ( Daudt et al., 2019 ) . To overcome the need for accurate change labels, unsupervised CD has been widely studied ( Malila, 1980 ; Nielsen and Conradsen, 1997 ; Volpi et al., 2012 ) , and is currently framed as anomaly detection, linking changes to high reconstruction errors ( Touati et al., 2020 ; Andresini et al., 2022 ; Béchaz et al., 2026 ; Růžička et al., 2022 ; Noh et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2021 ; Luppino et al., 2021 ) .
While most methods focus on binary change detection (BCD), real world scenarios require specifying the semantics of change.
SCD therefore extends BCD by assigning semantic labels to changes ( Daudt et al., 2019 ) . Early SCD methods used post-segmentation comparisons ( Huang et al., 2010 ; Hu and Zhang, 2013 ; Wu et al., 2017 ) and suffered from error accumulation and lack temporal modeling ( Volpi et al., 2013 ) .
Deep learning SCD methods have since become dominant and adopt end-to-end architectures that couple semantic segmentation and change detection ( Daudt et al., 2019 ; Zhu et al., 2022 ; Ding et al., 2024 ) .
Despite this progress, existing SCD methods remain rigid: they assume fixed categories, and treat them as independent labels, ignoring the hierarchical structure that naturally underlies land-cover semantics. These assumptions are unrealistic in real-world settings, where categories are progressively refined and semantically nested, and motivate our study of CI-SCD.
blocks.zh:
CD可以识别在不同时间获得的同一地点的遥感图像之间的差异。 最初以手工制作的地物为主(Malila,1980;Volpi等,2012.),近代方法带动了深度学习,典型的是暹罗设计(Daudt等,2018;Jiang等,2022.). 然而,这类方法依赖于地面真实变化图的质量,这些图很难获得,而且往往很吵(Daudt等,2019年)。 为了克服准确改变标签的需要,对未经监督的CD进行了广泛研究(Malila,1980年;Nielsen和Conradsen,1997年;Volpi等,2012年),目前被设定为异常探测(Touati等,2020年;Andresini等,2022年;Béchaz等,2026年;Růžička等,2022年;Noh等,2022年;Liu等,2021年;Luppino等,2021年)。
虽然大多数方法都注重二进制变化检测(BCD),但现实世界的情景需要具体说明变化的语义.
因此,SCD通过给变化分配语义标签来扩展BCD(Daudt等,2019年). 早期 SCD 方法采用分词后比较法(黄克.等,2010;胡克 and等,2013;吴克 al等,2017)并有误积并缺乏时间模型(沃尔皮等,2013.
深入学习的SCD方法从此成为主流,并采用了一对一语义分解和变化检测的端到端架构(Daudt等,2019;Zhu等,2022;Ding等,2024.).
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的SCD方法仍然僵硬:它们具有固定的类别,并作为独立的标签对待,忽略了自然构成土地覆盖语义基础的分级结构. 这些假设在现实世界中是不现实的,在现实世界中,类别逐渐被精炼和凝聚,并激励我们对CI-SCD的研究.

blocks.en: 2.2 Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.2 语义分类

blocks.en:
CISS addresses the problem of extending a segmentation model to new categories without forgetting previously learned ones. Existing CISS methods are replay-based, expansion-based, and distillation-based. Replay-based methods store past examples ( Cha et al., 2021 ) , or encode them using prototypes ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) and generative models ( Maracani et al., 2021 ) . Expansion-based approaches expand the model architecture to allocate components for new classes, e.g. via parallel branches or class-specific modules ( Zhang et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ) , or by preserving prior knowledge by freezing parameters associated with previously learned classes ( Srivastava et al., 2019 ; Cha et al., 2021 ) . Distillation-based methods constrain the updated model to preserve the previous responses on old classes, e.g. by distilling logits ( Cermelli et al., 2020 ; Michieli and Zanuttigh, 2019 ; Baek et al., 2022 ) , intermediate features ( Douillard et al., 2021 ; Michieli and Zanuttigh, 2019 ) or attention relations ( Qiu et al., 2023 ) .
Moreover, recent work showed that explicitly modeling semantic hierarchies, particularly using hyperbolic embedding spaces, significantly improves class-incremental segmentation via structured refinement ( Hindel et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2022 ) . In this work, we build upon these advances in CISS to address the specific problem of CI-SCD, where the taxonomy of the semantic classes is progressively refined on a corpus of images that remains fixed across incremental steps.
blocks.zh:
CISS处理将分门别类模式扩大到新类别而不忘记以前学到的类别的问题。 现有的CISS方法以回放为主,以扩展为主,以蒸馏为主. 基于回放的方法存储了过去的例子(Cha等,2021年),或使用原型(Chen等,2023年;Zhu等,2025年)和基因模型(Maracani等,2021年)编码. 基于扩展的方法扩展了模型架构,为新类分配组件,例如通过平行分支或特定类模块(张等,2022;萧等,2023;或通过冻结与以前学习的类相关的参数来保存先前的知识(斯里瓦斯塔瓦等,2019;查等,2021). 基于分解的方法制约了更新后的模式,以保留先前对旧类的反应,例如通过分解对数(Cermerli等,2020;Michieli和Zanuttigh,2019;Baek等,2022),中间特征(Douillard等,2021;Michieli和Zanuttigh,2019)或关注关系(Quu等,2023).
此外,最近的工作显示,明确模拟语义等级,特别是利用双曲嵌入空间,通过结构完善,大大改进了阶级-递增分化(Hindel等,2024;Lin等,2022)。 在这项工作中,我们利用独联体国家的这些进展,解决CI-SCD这一具体问题,在这个问题上,语义类的分类学在一系列图像的基础上逐步得到完善,这些图像仍然固定在渐进步骤上。

blocks.en: 2.3 Hyperbolic Spaces
blocks.zh: 2.3 双曲空格

blocks.en:
Hyperbolic geometry is particularly adapted to model hierarchical labels ( Nickel and Kiela, 2017 ; Ganea et al., 2018a ; Ganea et al., 2018b ) , with applications in classification ( Khrulkov et al., 2020 ) , object detection ( Liu et al., 2020 ; Lang et al., 2022 ) , and semantic segmentation ( Weber et al., 2024 ) . Ghadimi Atigh et al. (2022) showed that hyperbolic multinomial logistic regression improves performance and hierarchical consistency, particularly in low dimension, while Hindel et al. (2024) showed the importance of leveraging taxonomies. In this context, Busemann functions have shown promise ( Chami et al., 2021 ; Fan et al., 2023 ; Ghadimi Atigh et al., 2021 ; Berg et al., 2024 ; Berg et al., 2025 ) , extracting geometrically meaningful features that quantify dissimilarity to ideal prototypes located at infinity.
More recently, hyperbolic spaces have been explored for class-incremental settings, both in image classification ( Cui et al., 2023 ) and taxonomy-aware segmentation ( Hindel et al., 2024 ) , showing that hyperbolic embeddings can mitigate catastrophic forgetting by preserving hierarchical relations between classes. In our setting, where incremental refinement corresponds to splitting coarse land-cover categories into finer-grained ones, such hierarchical modeling is particularly well suited to maintain semantic consistency. We therefore adopt Busemann prototypes ( Berg et al., 2024 ; Berg et al., 2025 ) not only to structure hierarchical segmentation, but also to define the geometric basis of our semantic flow formulation for CI-SCD.

超曲面几何特别适应了模型分级标签(Nickel和Kiela,2017;Ganea等,2018a;Ganea等,2018b),其分类应用(Khrulkov等,2020年),对象检测. (Liu等,2020;Lang等,2022),和语义分解(Weber等,2024. 加迪米语Name Atigh等人(2022年)表明,双曲多名逻辑回归可以提高性能和等级一致性,特别是在低维度方面,而Hindel等人(2024年)则显示了利用分类学的重要性. 在这方面,Busemann功能显示出希望(Chami等人,2021年;Fan等人,2023年;Ghadimi)。 Atigh等, 2021; Berg等, 2024; Berg等, 2025),取出几何有意义的特征,将差异量化到位于无限的理想原型.
最近,在图像分类(Cui等,2023年)和分类-意识分解(Hindel等,2024年)中,对分级-递增设置的双曲空间进行了探索,表明分级嵌入可以通过保持分级关系来减轻灾难性的遗忘. 在我们的环境下,渐进的改进相当于将粗糙的土地覆盖类别分成更细的类别,这种等级模型特别适合于保持语义一致性。 因此,我们采用Busemann原型(Berg等,2024;Berg等,2025),不仅用于结构分层,而且用于定义我们语义流配方CI-SCD的几何基础.

blocks.en: 2.4 Riemannian Vector Fields
blocks.zh: 2.4 里曼病媒田径

blocks.en:
A natural way to model displacements in hyperbolic space is through vector fields
and their flow. Parameterizable vector fields on manifolds for deep learning tasks were first considered for extending neural Ordinary Differential Equations to the Riemannian setting ( Rezende et al., 2020 ; Falorsi and Forré, 2020 ; Mathieu and Nickel, 2020 ; Lou et al., 2020 ; Katsman et al., 2021 ) . While most approaches rely on extrinsic, Euclidean, formulations, ignoring the geometry of the manifold, Katsman et al. (2023) designed intrinsic vector fields in hyperbolic space for Riemannian ResNets, relying on the Busemann functions. Other designs were specifically investigated for images ( van Spengler et al., 2023 ) . In this work, we adopt the approach of Katsman et al. (2023) : we construct a vector field induced by the Busemann functions, in order to model natural shifts of the hyperbolic embeddings between the temporal images.

及其流动。 首次考虑将神经常态差异方程扩展到里曼环境(Rezende等人,2020年;Falorsi和Forré,2006年)。 2020; 马修和尼克尔, 2020; Lou等, 2020; Katsman等, 2021). 虽然大多数取道依赖于外相,欧几利得,配体,而忽略了多相体的几何,Katsman等(2023年)在双曲空间为Riemannian ResNets设计了内在向量场,依赖于Busemann函数. 对图像的其他设计进行了专门调查(van Spengler等,2023.)。 在这项工作中,我们采用了Katsman等人(2023年)的方法:我们构建了由Busemann函数所引导的向量场,以便模拟时间图像之间双曲嵌入的自然变化.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Class-Incremental Semantic Change Detection
blocks.zh: 3.1 分类-增量语义变化检测

blocks.en: Let I 0 , I 1 ∈ ℝ H × W × C in I_{0},I_{1}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C_{\mathrm{in}}} denote a co-registered pair of remote sensing (RS) images acquired at two times t 0 t_{0} and t 1 t_{1} . blocks.en:
To tackle semantic segmentation in hyperbolic space, we adopt the horospherical classifier from Berg et al. (2024) . It is based on Busemann prototypes, that play a central role in the change detection mechanism introduced later in section 3.5 .
We use a segmentation backbone where only the last network layer is mapped to hyperbolic space ( Hindel et al., 2024 ; Ghadimi Atigh et al., 2022 ; Khrulkov et al., 2020 ) .
Following Hindel et al. (2024) , we use the DeepLabV3 model with a ResNet-101 backbone pre-trained on ImageNet, and consider the d d -dimensional Poincaré ball model of hyperbolic space defined as 𝔹 d = { z ∈ ℝ d | ‖ z ‖ 2 < 1 } \mathbb{B}_{d}=\{z\in\mathbb{R}^{d}\>|\>\|z\|^{2}<1\} . Unless stated otherwise, d = 2 d=2 , which already provides competitive performance compared to baselines. Experiments in higher dimensions and with other backbones are in the Supplementary Materials F.2 and F.5 .

blocks.en: To train the segmentation module, we follow previous work on hierarchical semantic segmentation ( Li et al., 2023 ; Hindel et al., 2024 ) and leverage the class taxonomy. We frame the problem as a pixel-wise multi-label classification problem: for each pixel, the true leaf class and all its ancestors are labeled positive, while all other categories are labeled negative. We adopt a tree-min loss ( Li et al., 2023 ) that penalizes hierarchical inconsistencies. For each class k ∈ 𝒴 s k\in\mathcal{Y}_{s} , let A k A_{k} and D k D_{k} denote its ancestors and descendants in the label hierarchy (including OPEN k ) k) , and let l k ∈ { 0 , 1 } l_{k}\in\{0,1\} indicate whether k k is labeled as positive. The tree-min loss is defined as: ℒ hier = ∑ k ∈ 𝒴 s − l k log ( min u ∈ A k s u ) − ( 1 − l k ) log ( 1 − max u ∈ D k s u ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{hier}}=\sum_{k\in\mathcal{Y}_{s}}-l_{k}\log\left(\min_{u\in A_{k}}s_{u}\right)-(1-l_{k})\log\left(1-\max_{u\in D_{k}}s_{u}\right), (6) where s k = sigmoid ⁡ ( ξ k ) s_{k}=\mathrm{sigmoid}(\xi_{k}) . In addition to this hierarchical constraint, previous approaches ( Hindel et al., 2024 ) use a categorical cross-entropy loss at each hierarchical level to enforce competition between sibling classes. However, since our logits are derived from Busemann distances to hyperbolic prototypes, this approach was found to lead to bias toward parent prototypes and hinder fine-grained discrimination. We instead apply cross-entropy ℒ CE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CE}} on active leaf classes only. The same applies during inference, where only leaf logits are considered. Remaining differences between the predicted and true embeddings will indicate change, as depicted in fig. 1 , panel (3), framing CD as an anomaly detection problem. blocks.zh: 4个数据集

blocks.en: 4.1 HiChange
blocks.zh: 4.1 变化

blocks.en:
The analysis of hierarchical and incremental change detection requires the creation of a specialized dataset that accurately represents hierarchical relations within remote sensing images, as existing SCD datasets are limited to a small number of generic and static classes. To address this gap, we introduce HiChange, a novel dataset specifically designed for hierarchical and incremental semantic change detection in aerial imagery. HiChange is constructed from BDOrtho aerial imagery.
The dataset comprises 1000 1000 RGB-NIR tiles, each of size 5000 × 5000 5000\times 5000 pixels at 0.2 0.2 m spatial resolution, sampled over France, and partitioned geographically into training, validation, and test sets ( 70 % − 10 % − 20 % 70\%-10\%-20\% ), ensuring no spatial overlap across splits.
HiChange is fully annotated following a hierarchical taxonomy. Coarse semantic information derived from OCSGE is combined with detailed labels from FLAIR ( Garioud et al., 2025 ) and BDTopo to label each image at different semantic levels, for which the user can specify between 4 4 and 32 32 classes of interest.
Additional information on the dataset, including the complete hierarchical taxonomy, details on the label generation pipeline and the sampling strategy as well as statistics and comparison with existing benchmarks, is provided in the Supplementary Material A .
blocks.zh:
对分级和增量变化探测的分析需要创建一个专门数据集,准确代表遥感图像中的分级关系,因为现有的SCD数据集仅限于少数通用和静态类. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Hichange,这是专门为航空图像中的分级和递增语义变化探测而设计的一个新数据集. Hichange由BDortho航空影像所建.
数据集由1000个RGB-NIR瓷砖组成,每块大小为5000×5000\时以0.2米的空间分辨率取出5000像素,在法国上空取出样本,并按地域划分为训练,验证,测试等成套(70%-10%-20%-70××-10×-20××),确保分块之间没有空间重叠.
Hichange完全按照等级分类法注解. 由OCSGE所衍生出粗糙的语义信息与FLAIR(Garioud等,2025年)和BDTopo的详细标签结合在一起,以不同语义级别对每个图像进行标签,用户可以为此指定4个至32个兴趣类别.
关于数据集的更多信息,包括完整的分级分类、标签生成管道和取样战略的细节,以及统计和与现有基准的比较,见补充材料A。

blocks.en: 4.2 Additional Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.2 其他数据集

blocks.en:
While HiChange is the only available dataset with sufficient semantic richness to support hierarchical CI-SCD, we complement our evaluation with experiments on two widely used SCD benchmarks: SECOND ( Yang et al., 2020 ) and Hi-UCD-mini ( Tian et al., 2020 ) .
Although these datasets do not support incremental evaluation, they allow us to validate the segmentation backbone and Busemann vector field–based change detection mechanism, demonstrating that our approach generalizes beyond HiChange.
More details on these datasets can be found in Supplementary Materials B .

blocks.en: 5.1 Does Hyperbolic Semantic Flow Enable Effective CD?
blocks.zh: 5.1 双曲语义流能启用有效的CD吗?

blocks.en:
We first compare HyperFlow against unsupervised CD baselines across the three datasets. We also report the performance of the fully supervised SCD method HRSCD4 ( Daudt et al., 2019 ) as an upper-bound reference. Implementation details are given in the Supplementary Materials D , and qualitative examples are provided in fig. 2 , panel (1). Numerically, table 1 shows that HyperFlow consistently outperforms competing approaches across all datasets.
To isolate the contribution of the learned vector field, we additionally compare against a naive baseline that defines change as the difference between the segmentation of the two input images (Segm. diff.). Although this baseline already surpasses several unsupervised methods, and thus suggests that strong semantic segmentation alone can outperform many unsupervised CD approaches, an important performance gap remains with HyperFlow. This difference highlights that in the naive baseline small variations in appearance between the images can slightly modify the semantic embeddings, potentially leading to label changes in the output even when no real semantic change occurred. In contrast, HyperFlow operates directly in the embedding space and measures deviations of a semantic flow accounting for these variations. These irrelevant changes are therefore not accounted for, and only deviations that cannot be explained by the learned semantic flow, i.e . , semantically significant movement in the embedding space, are identified as changes.
This mechanism is illustrated in fig. 2 , panel (2): only pixels corresponding to true changes (shown in red) undergo significant displacement between timestamps. The hyperbolic flow therefore controls segmentation-induced errors, explaining the improvement over simple segmentation differencing, also visible in fig. 2 , panel (1).

blocks.en:
When compared with existing unsupervised methods, the strong CD results in table 1 may raise concerns about the unsupervised nature of HyperFlow, given that not only the prototypes but also the embeddings are obtained from supervised segmentation, therefore influencing the performance of Hyperflow. We emphasize that our unsupervised claim concerns the CD stage only. For CD, the supervised segmentation backbone acts purely as a feature extractor, and in this sense, Hyperflow follows common practices in unsupervised CD of using supervised pretrained feature extractors ( Saha et al., 2019 ; Lei et al., 2026 ; Bergamasco et al., 2022 ; Du et al., 2018 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . HyperFlow differs in that the features are specifically adapted to the target domain and semantic task, thus yielding stronger features for CD, but HyperFlow could also operate on embeddings obtained through either supervised or unsupervised pretraining, with their quality and task/domain specificity naturally affecting downstream CD performance.
To support this statement, table 1 also reports results using embeddings from two foundation models: SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) and AnySat ( Astruc and others, 2025 ) , the latter being RS-specific. Even with these fully unsupervised embeddings, HyperFlow achieves performance comparable to SOTA unsupervised CD methods. Moreover, for HiChange and Hi-UCD-mini, performance improves from SAM3 to AnySat, consistent with increasing specialization to the RS domain. Thus, while supervised segmentation embeddings contribute to the strong results observed with HyperFlow, they are not required for competitive unsupervised CD performance. More generally, HyperFlow benefits from strong representations, regardless of how they are obtained.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce HyperFlow, a method that bridges CISS and SCD via hyperbolic semantic flow. By representing semantic categories with Busemann prototypes and modeling temporal evolution of semantic classes as a learned vector field in hyperbolic space, we formulate CD as the identification of deviations from expected temporal dynamics. We train and evaluate HyperFlow on HiChange, a new large-scale, very high resolution and hierarchical SCD dataset that we propose. Our results demonstrate that formulating semantic change as a hyperbolic flow enables effective unsupervised CD while preserving competitive segmentation performance, both in standard and in incremental settings. Furthermore, we show that progressively refining the taxonomy, i.e . the semantic changes considered, rather than considering all changes from the beggining, helps considerably the task of fine-grained semantic change detection. Although the CD mechanism does not require supervision, HyperFlow still depends on the quality of the semantic segmentation model. Future works will focus on learning better representations for the semantic segmentation backbone, for instance leveraging foundation models based on large scale self-supervised pretraining ( Sumbul et al., 2025 ; Cong et al., 2022 ) . Moreover, we will explore leveraging longer time series, which could enable the modeling of more complex or gradual temporal transitions, such as seasonal vegetation cycles or multi-stage urban development, thereby providing a richer representation of temporal dynamics.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了HyperFlow,这种方法通过双曲语义流来连接CISS和SCD. 通过以布斯曼原型代表语义类,并模拟语义类作为双曲空间中一个有学问的矢量场的时间演化,我们制定了CD作为识别与预期时间动态的偏差. 我们在Hichange上训练和评价HyperFlow,这是我们提出的一个新的大规模,非常高的分辨率和分级的SCD数据集. 我们的结果显示,将语义变化表述为双曲流,能够有效实现不受监督的CD,同时在标准环境和增量环境中保持竞争性分化性能。 此外,我们表明,逐步改进分类学,即所考虑的语义变化,而不是考虑从乞食中作出的所有变化,对精细的语义变化探测任务大有帮助。 虽然CD机制不需要监督,但HyperFlow仍然取决于语义分解模型的质量. 今后的工作将侧重于为语义分解主干部分学习更好的表述,例如利用基于大规模自我监督预训的基础模型(Sumbul等,2025;Cong等,2022)。 此外,我们将探索利用较长的时间序列,从而能够模拟更为复杂或逐步的时间过渡,如季节性植被周期或多阶段城市发展,从而更充分地反映时间动态。

blocks.en: A.2 Sampling of the Images
blocks.zh: A.2 图像取样

blocks.en: In this section, we detail the sampling procedure used to construct the HiChange dataset. The objective was to select a subset of tiles from the French national BDOrtho aerial imagery database 1 1 1 https://geoservices.ign.fr/bdortho that maximizes the diversity and relevance of observed semantic changes. We fixed the total number of tiles to N = 1000 N=1000 , a choice made to balance dataset size, semantic diversity, and feasible training time for deep-learning models. Each tile has a spatial resolution of 0.2 0.2 m and a size of 5000 × 5000 5000\times 5000 pixels. The sampling procedure consists of three main stages described below.

blocks.en: To ensure that the final dataset focuses on regions with actual changes, we perform an initial selection of tiles based on the density of changes within each tile. For this purpose, we use the OCSGE database 2 2 2 https://geoservices.ign.fr/ocsge , which we also employ for change label generation. As OCSGE is available only for specific years depending on the region, we select BDOrtho acquisition years to match the available OCSGE years to ensure temporal consistency. Acquisition years range from 2016 to 2023, and time between the 2 acquisitions for each pair is 2 to 3 years. OCSGE is provided as a vector dataset in which each changed object is represented as a polygon. For each tile in BDOrtho, we count the number of OCSGE polygons falling within its spatial extent. We retain only tiles containing more than 30 30 polygons of change. This threshold was chosen to filter out tiles without meaningful change activity. blocks.en: Even after the initial filtering, the number of candidate tiles remains far larger than the desired dataset size. The final selection aims to (i) maximize diversity in the types of observed semantic changes and (ii) balance the relative frequency of change categories. To this end, we exploit the land-cover attributes provided by OCSGE and adopt an iterative greedy selection procedure. For each change polygon, its change type is defined as the combination of the dominant semantic labels before and after change ( i.e . , an ordered pair ( category before , category after ) (\mathrm{category}_{\mathrm{before}},\mathrm{category}_{\mathrm{after}}) ). For each train-test-validation split, we run the tile selection procedure as follows: 1. Initialize the selected tile set as empty. 2. For each unselected tile in the split: • Simulate adding the tile to the current selection. • Compute the deviation between the resulting distribution of change types and the target uniform distribution across all change types. • Measure the reduction in deviation that would result from adding the tile. 3. Select the tile that yields the greatest improvement. 4. Repeat until the desired number of tiles K K for the split is reached.

blocks.en: A.3 Generation of the Labels
blocks.zh: A.3 标签的生成

blocks.en: The pipeline for the generation of the labels is presented in Figure 4 . The change detection labels are derived from the OCSGE database, which provides coarse annotations of both land-cover segmentation and change between two temporal acquisitions. We directly exploit the change information from OCSGE as a binary indication of change. This change map is later refined at usage time to align with the selected semantic granularity, as detailed later in this section. However, the semantic segmentation labels provided by OCSGE remain coarse and cover only a limited set of semantic categories 3 3 3 https://geoservices.ign.fr/sites/default/files/2025-10/DC_OCSGE_NG.pdf . This level of detail is insufficient for the objectives of HiChange, which require fine-grained semantic information. Therefore, additional sources of information are incorporated to construct richer semantic labels. In particular, we leverage the BDTopo database 4 4 4 https://geoservices.ign.fr/bdtopo from the French National Institute of Geographic and Forest Information (IGN) which provides high-precision vector layers describing buildings, roads, and other man-made infrastructure for multiple years. A key limitation, however, is that BDTopo is not spatially exhaustive: several regions of the territory remain unlabeled or only partially covered. One possible remedy would be to supplement BDTopo with the OCSGE semantic segmentation data, but the latter is too coarse for our target spatial resolution ( 0.2 0.2 m). To overcome this limitation, we employ the FLAIR land-cover model Garioud et al. (2025) , which was also trained on BDOrtho imagery and has demonstrated high accuracy on segmentation tasks. We run FLAIR inference over all tiles and use its predicted land-cover labels in regions not covered by BDTopo. The resulting semantic segmentation combines BDTopo-derived vector information where available and FLAIR predictions elsewhere, thereby achieving both fine-grained semantic resolution and full spatial coverage.

blocks.en: The above procedure yields semantic labels at the finest level of granularity. These labels are organized into a hierarchical taxonomy structured in three levels, as shown in fig. 5 . When using the dataset, the user selects the desired classes to consider. Fine-grained categories are then automatically mapped to their parent categories when coarser levels are requested.

blocks.en: To ensure coherence between the semantic segmentation labels and the change annotations, we apply a filtering mechanism to the change map at usage time. Specifically, if the selected classes are coarse and a tile exhibits a change only between child categories belonging to the same parent category ( e.g . , a change from forest to grass when only vegetation is considered), the change should not be reported. We therefore mark as changed only pixels that are both (i) marked as changed by OCSGE and (ii) present different semantic labels between the two timestamps at the chosen semantic level. This guarantees that the binary change masks remain semantically meaningful and consistent across hierarchical configurations, and solves at the same time the problem of the coarse resolution of OCSGE.
blocks.zh: 为了确保语义分解标签和更改说明之间的一致性,我们在使用时间对更改地图采用过滤机制. 具体地说,如果所选的班级粗糙而瓷砖只显示属于同一父母类别的儿童类别之间有所变化(例如,在只考虑植被时从森林改为草地),则不应报告这种变化。 因此,我们标记为只被更改的像素,既(一)被OCSGE所标记为被更改的像素,(二)在所选择的语义水平上,在两个倍数标记之间呈现出不同的语义标签. 这保证了二进制变换口罩在分级配置上仍然具有生动意义并保持一致性,同时解决了OCSGE的粗心解析问题.

blocks.en: The construction of such a large dataset involves a trade-off between annotation quality and coverage. Some regions in the dataset where BDTopo is unavailable are labeled using FLAIR. These automatically generated labels may inherit biases and errors from the model, and may therefore introduce some noise into the benchmark. In addition, the use of OCSGE may exclude changes that fall below its minimum mapping unit. However, given the scale of the dataset, manual annotation is not practically feasible. The adopted methodology provides a compromise that enables large-scale evaluation while acknowledging the limitations associated with automatically generated labels.
blocks.zh: 构建这样一个大型数据集涉及在注释质量和覆盖面之间取舍。 数据集中一些没有BDTopo的区域使用FLAIR进行标签. 这些自动生成的标签可能继承模型的偏差和出错,因此可能会给基准带来一些噪音. 此外,使用OCSGE可能会排除低于其最低映射单位的变化. 然而,鉴于数据集的规模,手工注释实际上并不可行。 所采用的方法提供了一种折衷办法,可以进行大规模评价,同时承认与自动生成标签有关的限制。

blocks.en: Hyperbolic spaces are Riemannian manifolds with the particular property of having constant negative curvature. This curvature controls how much the space looks like a tree. blocks.en: Following established work in SCD, our formulation deliberately keeps (and evaluates) the change map and the semantic segmentation maps as separate outputs rather than combining them into a single from-to transition map. The latter would couple the errors of individual predictions without providing additional information. The notion of change consistency in our work should therefore be understood at the level of the incremental task rather than as a hard pixel-wise constraint. HyperFlow does not enforce change and semantic prediction to be consistent at every pixel. However, as the semantic taxonomy evolves, both semantic segmentation and change detector evolve to enable the change maps to describe changes within the new semantic classes considered.
blocks.zh: 在SCD的既定工作之后,我们的配方有意保留(并评价)变化图和语义分解图作为单独的输出,而不是将它们合并为从一个从一个到一个到一个到一个的从一个到一个的图. 后者将合并个别预测的错误,而不提供补充资料。 因此,应当从增量任务的角度来理解我们工作中变化一致性的概念,而不是一个硬像素的制约。 HyperFlow不强制改变和语义预测,使每个像素一致. 然而,随着语义分类学的演化,语义分解和变化探测器都会演化出使变化图能够描述所考虑的新语义类内的变化.

blocks.en: F.1 Influence and Choice of the Threshold
blocks.zh: F.1 门槛的影响和选择

blocks.en: The CD part of HyperFlow, based on hyperbolic semantic flows, needs a threshold at inference to transform a continuous reconstruction error into a binary prediction. To obtain binary CD from the distance between the embeddings without relying on ground-truth labels, we require an unsupervised thresholding method. Otsu’s method ( Otsu, 1979 ) , although commonly used, is unsuitable here, as it assumes a bimodal histogram, whereas our distance distribution is dominated by the unchanged mode with a much smaller tail of change scores, as observed in fig. 14 . Under this imbalance, Otsu does not provide a suitable threshold. We instead use the Triangle algorithm ( Zack et al., 1977 ) , which is designed for exactly this type of skewed distribution: it selects the threshold as the point of maximum perpendicular distance between the histogram and the line connecting its peak to its tail.
blocks.zh: HyperFlow的CD部分,以双曲语义流为基础,在推论上需要一个阈值来将连续的重建错误转化为二进制预测. 为了从嵌入体之间的距离获得二进制CD而无需依赖地上真实的标签,我们需要一种不受监督的阈值方法. 大津的方法(Otsu,1979年)虽然常用,但在此不合适,因为它假设的是双模式直方图,而我们的距离分布则以不变模式为主,变化分数的尾巴要小得多,如图所示. 14,在这种不平衡下,大津并没有提供适当的门槛. 我们而是使用三角算法(Zack等,1977年),这个算法正是为这种扭曲分布而设计的:它选择了阈值作为直方图与连接其峰值与尾部的线之间的最大垂直距离的点.

While the performance depends on the choice of the threshold, we note that the range in which our model outperforms other unsupervised methods remains large. We therefore keep this value for all experiments involving HiChange. The threshold value is however adapted for the other two datasets, and when using SAM3 and AnySat as embeddings encoder, as the distribution of the change scores may vary significantly in those cases. Similarly, when considering the Euclidean vector fields, the thresholds are adapted to the range of change scores values encountered. The values retained are summarized in table 7 .

blocks.en: F.2 Influence of the Backbone Architecture
blocks.zh: F.2 后骨结构的影响

blocks.en: All experiments presented in the main paper rely on a single backbone (Deep-LabV3 with a ResNet-101 backbone pre-trained on ImageNet) to ensure fair comparison across methods. We now investigate how the choice of backbone affects both segmentation and change detection performance. In particular, we consider a simpler UNet backbone. Results are provided in table 8 . As expected, the performance obtained with the UNet backbone is lower than with DeepLabV3. This difference is mainly explained by the smaller model size ( 1.3 1.3 M parameters compared to 58 58 M), and the absence of pretraining. Consequently, segmentation performance decreases, which impacts CD and SCD, as good change detection relies on the quality of the underlying segmentation. Nevertheless, it can be observed that for T 4 0 T_{4}^{0} , the CD performance for the UNet backbone (F1 = 14.5 =14.5 ) remains similar to those of the unsupervised methods reported in table 1 . This result indicates that HyperFlow still provides effective CD even when relying on a weaker segmentation model.

blocks.en: F.3 Do we really need to use the segmentation prototypes?
blocks.zh: F.3 联合国 我们真的需要使用分块原型吗?

blocks.en: The current formulation reuses the Busemann prototypes learned for segmentation as anchors for the vector field. An alternative is to use uniformly distributed prototypes, either learned or fixed. While this provides greater flexibility and allows HyperFlow to operate without segmentation-derived embeddings, which is particularly relevant for non-semantic CD tasks or when using general embeddings not obtained from segmentation pretext tasks, as in table 1 with SAM3 and AnySat, it may discard part of the semantic information encoded in the learned segmentation prototypes. Table 9 compares CD performance using prototypes derived from the segmentation task and prototypes independent of segmentation, both with and without prototype learning. While using non-segmentation prototypes leads to a performance drop, the resulting CD performance remains competitive, demonstrating that HyperFlow can also operate on prototypes not derived from a segmentation pretext task. Learning the prototypes partially closes the gap with segmentation-based prototypes, although not entirely. This can be explained by the fact that CD ultimately concerns changes in semantic content. Segmentation embeddings and prototypes therefore provide a natural basis for modeling this semantic flow.
blocks.zh: 目前的配体再用Busemann原型作为向量场的锚地被分解而学习出. 另一种办法是使用统一分布的原型机,无论是学习过的还是固定的. 虽然这提供了更大的灵活性并允许HyperFlow在不分解衍生嵌入的情况下运行,这与非语义CD任务特别相干,或者在使用分解借口任务中未得到的一般嵌入时,如有SAM3和AnySat的表1,它可能会丢弃被所学分解原型所编码的部分语义信息. 表9利用从分块任务中衍生出来的原型和独立于分块的原型对CD性能进行比较,无论有无原型学习. 虽然使用非分块原型会导致性能下降,但由此产生的CD性能仍然具有竞争力,表明HyperFlow也可以运行在原型上,而不是由分块借口任务所衍生出. 学习原型部分地用以分化为主的原型来弥补差距,虽然并不完全如此. 其原因是,裁谈会最终涉及语义内容的变化。 因此分化嵌入和原型为模拟这种语义流提供了自然的基础.

blocks.en: F.4 Does working in Hyperbolic space help?
blocks.zh: F.4 联合国 在双曲空间工作有帮助吗?

blocks.en: One of the main hypotheses of this work is that exploiting hyperbolic geometry can improve the CI-SCD task. While Hindel et al. (2024) demonstrated the benefits of hyperbolic representations for CISS on natural images, it remains unclear whether these advantages also extend to change detection (CD) in remote sensing imagery. To investigate this question, we consider two Euclidean counterparts to the proposed Busemann vector field framework. The first preserves the overall methodology while replacing the hyperbolic Busemann function with its Euclidean analogue, namely a scalar product. This variant therefore retains the same formulation and training procedure, differing only in the underlying geometry. The second removes the Busemann formulation entirely, as it is no longer required in Euclidean space, and instead trains a neural network to directly predict the next embeddings. We refer to these two variants as Euc-Bus. and Euc , respectively, and compare their performance on the CD task with the proposed hyperbolic approach in table 10(a) .
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要假设之一是利用双曲几何可以改进CI-SCD任务. Hindel等人(2024年)证明了CISS对自然图像的双曲表示的好处,但目前仍不清楚这些优点是否也扩展到遥感图像中的变化探测(CD). 为了调查这个问题,我们认为拟议的布斯曼向量场框架有两个欧几利德的对应方。 第一种保留了整体方法,同时用其欧几利得模拟(Euclidean mobulue)来取而代之的是双曲布斯曼函数,即斯卡尔克产品. 因此,这一变式保留了相同的表述和培训程序,仅在基本几何方面有所不同。 第二种完全去除布斯曼配体,因为它在欧几利得空间已经不再需要了,而是训练出神经网络来直接预测接下来的嵌入. 我们把这两个变体分别称为Euc-Bus和Euc,并将其在裁谈会任务方面的表现与表10(a)中提议的双曲法相比较。

blocks.en: We observe a clear superiority of the hyperbolic formulation. However, in our experiments, the threshold obtained using the triangle-based method for the Euclidean variants was not optimal. This can be attributed to the quite different distribution of embeddings in Euclidean space: compared to hyperbolic embeddings, the embeddings exhibit smaller pairwise distances, as those distances do not grow exponentially. To provide a fairer comparison and remove artifacts of thresholding behavior, we therefore manually selected the optimal threshold for both the Euc-Bus. and Euc formulations. Table 10(b) reports their performance using these thresholds, alongside that of the standard hyperbolic HyperFlow with its optimal threshold ( d thresh = 6 d_{\mathrm{thresh}}=6 , see fig. 15 ). Although the performance gap is reduced, the overall trend remains unchanged: the hyperbolic version outperforms its Euclidean counterparts.
blocks.zh: 我们观测到双曲配方的明显优势. 然而,在我们的实验中,使用以三角法为基础的欧几利得变体获得的阈值并不理想. 这可以归因于嵌入物在欧几利得空间的分布相当不同:与双曲嵌入物相比,嵌入物呈现出较小的双向相距,因为这些相距没有指数增长. 为了提供更公平的比较并去除阈值行为的文物,我们因此手动选择了欧克-Bus和欧克配方的最佳阈值. 表10(b)报告了它们使用这些阈值的性能,连同标准双曲超流及其最佳阈值的性能(d thesh = 6 d_{\ mathrm{thresh}}=6,见图15)一样。 尽管性能差距缩小了,但总体趋势保持不变:双曲版的性能超过了欧几利得式的性能。

blocks.en: Despite these results and the fact that higher dimension could potentially provide better performances, especially if we consider the SCD performance, we keep d = 2 d=2 in the main experiments for three reasons. First, this configuration already surpasses competing methods. Second, 2 2 -dimensional embeddings enable direct visualization of the learned representations, which provides useful insights into the semantic structure and the learned flow. Third, it reduces the number of parameters in the model. While higher dimensions slightly improve the SCD (SCS) score, the gains remain limited and do not justify the additional parameters.

blocks.en: F.6 Failure Cases
blocks.zh: F.6 失败案件

blocks.en: Figure 16 presents typical examples of failure cases. Two main sources of errors can be identified. The first is errors in the predicted segmentation. As illustrated by the first two examples, inaccuracies in the predicted land-cover propagate to the change map. This is consistent with the results discussed in section 5.1 : the quality of the embeddings directly affects the quality of the resulting CD, and, for the segmentation embeddings used here, this quality is closely related to the accuracy of the land-cover segmentation. The second reason comes from errors in the ground-truth annotations, as observed in the last two examples.
